description: Hand the Check payment to the server once it is mined. The server reads it on-chain (the payer signed it, the network USDC reached the fee wallet, at least the price, after the charge, the mark) and reserves the hash for this Check only. 201 with check.status paid: the credit exists. analysis_payment_pending (409): not mined yet, call again in a few seconds. analysis_payment_rejected (400, details.reason): this transaction does not pay this Check. tx_already_used (409): the hash already paid something else. Repeating the same hash is safe; never pay again.

access.description: The Check access of this payer from check_access (vca_...). Secret: it reads and spends this payer's credits.

txHash.description: The EVM transaction hash or the Solana signature.

name: check_report_payment
